biotools.summary: ADToolbox is a Python package for modeling anaerobic digestion metabolism, incorporating metagenomic information to enhance VFA production accuracy. It provides command-line interfaces, a Python API, and facilitates large-scale metagenomic analyses and modeling simulations.
biotools.name: ADToolbox
